verdict.rationale: There is no first-party retention or deletion control for the hosted API. The docs only disclose that the same URL is cached for 5 minutes (jina-reader-docs-7). Retention control is mostly implied through self-hosting the open-source image (jina-reader-gh-8) and pointing the page cache at your own S3-compatible bucket (jina-reader-gh-20), which puts cached data under the user's own storage. missing for 10: a documented retention policy, a cache opt-out or no-cache header for the SaaS, API or account-level data deletion, and independent corroboration.
